## Skill PR Checklist

**Type of change:**
- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Update to existing skill
- [ ] Fix (typo, broken example, outdated info)
- [ ] Registry/tooling change

**For new skills and updates:**
- [ ] SKILL.md has required frontmatter (name, version, author, tags, compatibleModes)
- [ ] Skill is between 100-400 lines
- [ ] "When to use this skill" section is present and specific
- [ ] index.json has been updated with correct id, description, version, and raw GitHub URL
- [ ] I've tested this skill against at least one real project
- [ ] No placeholder content — all sections are complete

**Description of changes:**

**Tested with:** (Atlarix version, OS, example project type)
